prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE finished square children's storybook illustration, high resolution, no panels or collage. Dreamy hand-painted watercolor on subtly textured ivory paper, translucent lavender, sky-blue, rose and warm golden washes, soft natural faces, luminous light, delicate pencil detail, charming composition. Family photograph is appearance reference only, not a scene to reproduce. Existing swimming illustration is reference for Ayla and Asher's appearance only. Avi is ALWAYS a small INFANT BABY, with round cheeks, very sparse light brown baby hair, soft baby proportions, ALWAYS wearing rainbow-striped baby clothing and rainbow bib (or rainbow-striped baby rain suit for rain). Miri is age FOUR, fair skin, BLONDE hair in TWO BRAIDS, BOTH UPPER FRONT TEETH MISSING, show conspicuous little gap in smiles, lilac dress (lilac raincoat outdoors in rain). Abba fair skin swept wavy brown hair short beard, Mama fair skin brown ponytail, no mandatory hat/sunglasses. Ayla preschool girl dark brown high ponytail yellow dress, Asher preschool boy short wavy brown hair teal shirt. Keep recognizable likeness naturally illustrated, not photographic faces. Babies cradled, lying down or safely supported; magic is playful make-believe. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, musical notation, frame, or decorative border. Scene: Cover: Infant Avi in a cream rainbow-striped footed romper and rainbow bib, cradled securely in smiling Miri’s lap as she sits on a soft fluffy cloud. A gentle small ivory unicorn with pastel mane curls beside them, a broad luminous rainbow curves behind them. Miri wears a lilac dress. Faces in lower two thirds, top quarter quiet pale sky for a separately rendered HTML title. No writing.
